   "category" : "changelog",
   "content" : "Revision history for HTTP-Message-Signature:

v0.1.2    2026-11-28 15:16:14+00:00 Europe/London
  [Bug Fixes]
  - Fixed checks of created and expires paramaters, GH#2.

v0.1.1    2026-11-28 14:24:49+00:00 Europe/London
  [Security]
  - Added a default max_size and timeout to the user_agent that retrieves public keys. (CVE-2026-138258)

  - The public_key_json decoder will set a max_body_size to max_public_keys_json_size. (CVE-2026-138259)

  [Bug Fixes]
  - @query changed to use uri, not uri_canonical.

  - The request attribute updated to allow Plack::Request objects.

  [Documentation]
  - Updated description of is_expired and verify_public_keys.

  - Fix documentation for max_keys.

  - Updated SECURITY CONSIDERATIONS to discuss security settings.

  [Tests]
  - Removed hard requirement for Plack in the tests.

v0.1.0    2026-11-27 21:42:02+00:00 Europe/London
  [Enhancements]
  - Added an options hash reference to the verify method.

  - Changed the verify method to check expiration and creation times by default.

  - Added support for verifying responses.

  - The signature_agent attribute will coerce a URI.

  - Added alias request and response constructor attributes.

  - Added option to verify public keys when they are retrieved from the signatures-directory.

  [Bug Fixes]
  - Bumped minimum version of HTTP::libsfparse to a non-broken version.

  [Documentation]
  - Amended Changes.

  [Tests]
  - Report versions of additional prereqs of HTTP::libsfparse.

v0.0.4    2026-11-27 12:43:51+00:00 Europe/London
  [Security]
  - Added max_keys attribute to truncate public keys. (CVE-2026-138257)

  [Bug Fixes]
  - Removed unused prerequisite.

  - Bumped minimum version of HTTP::libsfparse.
    (This was supposed to be an enhancement, but was broken.)

  [Tests]
  - Added more test data.

v0.0.3    2026-11-26 16:53:57+00:00 Europe/London
  [Enhancements]
  - Changed the internals to use HTTP::libsfparse (via HTTP::StructuredField) for parsing structured fields.

  - Added support for the rsa-pss-sha512 algorithm.

  - The public key is checked if it corresponds to the algorithm.

  [Bug Fixes]
  - Fixed the regex used to match dictionary keys.

  [Documentation]
  - Added a section to KNOWN ISSUES about Content-Digests.

v0.0.2    2026-11-19 18:00:54+00:00 Europe/London
  [Bug Fixes]
  - Removed use of "equ" operator and state hash variables that caused problems with older Perl versions.

  - Specify minimum version of List::Util.

  [Documentation]
  - Fixed broken Changes file.

  - Move STATUS section to the top.

v0.0.1  2026-11-19 16:01:20
  - Initial version uploaded to CPAN.
